name: Aranda de Duero (Spain)
description: Light blue field charged at the centre with the crowned arms of Aranda de Duero (a bridge above waves on blue, with supporters).
history: Municipal flag of Aranda de Duero; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Aranda de Duero arms — bridge above waves with supporters
